Air India Issued Notice After Italians Departed Delhi Without Checks

Air India has been issued a show-cause notice by the Civil Aviation Ministry after three Italian passengers departed from Delhi without undergoing immigration clearance. The notice requires Air India to provide detailed explanations for the lapse. The incident involved passengers leaving the country without the necessary checks.
